Samir Patel: Quick ask — our Backend SWE onsite on Fri 2026-04-10 10am PT has two panelists who just flagged conflicts. Can anyone swap to Thu 2026-04-09 3-4pm PT? If not, can we triage who is essential?
Maya Nguyen: I can swap off Fri if you need me on Thu, but FYI I only have 3:15–3:45pm free on Thu. Does that help?
Jordan Lee: I can't move other meetings but can cover the systems portion on Thu 3–4. Who else would need to be there for culture/rubric?
Samir Patel: Thanks both. We ideally want one infra/systems, one design/culture, and a hiring manager. Hiring mgr (Priya) is stuck on Fri. If Maya can only do 3:15–3:45, that might still work if we split.
Alex Ribeiro: I can shift to Thu 2–4 if that unblocks. Happy to take design/culture and do the rubric notes.
Maya Nguyen: Perfect — @Alex Ribeiro + @Jordan Lee, can you coordinate split: Jordan leads systems (3:00–3:30), Alex does culture + debrief (3:30–4:00), Maya joins 3:15–3:45 for overlap?
Samir Patel: That plan works for me. Two quick rubric clarifications before we finalize: 1) For 'Problem decomposition', are we still using 1–4 where 3 means "good with tradeoffs"? 2) For 'Ownership/impact', do we prefer concrete metrics/examples or hypothesis-based answers?
Jordan Lee: Yes 1–4 scale still. Use 4 = exceptional (goes beyond prompt, clear performance/complexity tradeoffs), 3 = solid with tradeoffs.
Alex Ribeiro: For Ownership, prefer concrete examples (metrics where possible). If candidate gives hypothesis that's ok but annotate as "hypothetical" in notes.
Maya Nguyen: Quick template to paste into the debrief thread: ```
- Summary: 1–2 lines
- Strengths: bullets
- Areas to probe: bullets
- Score (1–4) per rubric category
- Hire rec (No/Maybe/Yes)
```
PanelBot: calendar update: Event "Backend SWE onsite (adjusted)" moved to 2026-04-09T22:00:00Z — attendees: Samir Patel, Jordan Lee, Alex Ribeiro, Maya Nguyen, Priya Sharma
Samir Patel: @Priya Sharma (cc), asking if you can confirm the Thu slot since you were the blocker. If not, we can fallback to doing the panel with a hiring manager present remotely.
Samir Patel: tagging this thread as actionable — will update the interview block after Priya confirms. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Alex Ribeiro: I'll prep the short rubric prompt and paste into the debrief doc after the loop. Won't take long.
Maya Nguyen: ETA: I'll confirm my precise calendar move by EOD.
Jordan Lee: If something falls through, I can run the session solo and mark culture as deferred. But prefer the 3-person split.
Samir Patel: Last note — please mark any "hypothetical" answers in your notes (prefix with [HYP]) so ops can filter during hire sync. Cheers.
